description: This file contains shell script functions related to firmware upgrade management for Linksys devices within OpenWrt. It includes functions to determine the target firmware partition and perform the upgrade process, with device-specific logic.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition ('kernel1' or 'kernel2') based on the current boot environment.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs platform-specific firmware upgrade steps, including partition selection, lock handling, and invoking upgrade commands based on firmware magic number.
